# HRain ### Local-first cognitive graph workspace ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active%20prototype-2f81f7) ![Class](https://img.shields.io/badge/class-interaction%20prototype-6e7681)
## Status **Active Prototype.** HRain is implemented and usable as a browser workspace, but it remains a prototype. Interfaces, AI-assistance behavior, and validation may change. ## Abstract HRain turns notes, ideas, and short inputs into an editable visual graph. It is browser-based, can run locally/offline, and can optionally use model-assisted suggestions when configured. ## Implemented scope - D3.js force-directed graph interaction; - draggable nodes and links; - per-node context; - JSON import/export; - touch/mouse interaction; - browser-local/offline mode; - optional model-assisted suggestions; - dedicated read-only JANUS Meta Registry graph viewer; - living Registry Mode physics with organic links, impulses, breathing membranes, DIVE/ASCEND navigation and dynamic ambience; - read-only DemiHead `LEFT_HRAIN` hemisphere sidecar with deterministic packet normalization. ## DemiHead left hemisphere HRain now has a separate [`demihead.html`](demihead.html) sidecar and [`demihead-bridge.js`](demihead-bridge.js) packet builder for the JANUS DemiHead bicameral bridge. The naming is a **software architecture metaphor**, not a neuroscience claim: ```text HRain / LEFT_HRAIN = STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT DemiHead = bind / compare / preserve disagreement iNaiHR / RIGHT_INAIHR = ASSOCIATIVE_CONTEXT ``` The sidecar reads only the current browser-local HRain workspace and emits `janus.demihead.hemisphere_packet.v1`. It does not write back to HRain, iNaiHR, JANUS Meta Registry, GitHub, or any external platform. Legacy nodes that do not already contain explicit origin metadata are exported as `LEGACY_UNKNOWN`; the bridge does not guess that they were human-authored. ```text HEMISPHERE_METAPHOR != NEUROSCIENCE_CLAIM STRUCTURE != COMMAND BOTH_HEMISPHERES_AGREE != TRUTH PACKET_TRANSFER = READ_ONLY DIRECT_CROSS_HEMISPHERE_MUTATION = false AUTHORITY_DELTA = 0 MASS_EFFECT_BUDGET_DELTA = 0 ``` The sidecar can also answer an explicit `JANUS_DEMIHEAD_REQUEST_PACKET_V1` `postMessage` from the same GitHub Pages origin or localhost development origin and responds only to that exact origin, never to `*`. ## JANUS Meta Registry bridge `janus.html` is a separate **read-only Registry Mode**. It consumes the automatically generated index published by [`Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry`](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry) and renders the active registry projection as: ```text JANUS Meta Registry → research surfaces → versioned registry objects → authoritative source URL ``` Live Registry Mode: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/Hrain/janus.html The ordinary HRain workspace remains separate and editable. Registry Mode does not write back to the Meta Registry and does not replace source JSON, current-authority records, receipts or code. `WIPE LOCAL DESK` in Registry Mode is deliberately **not a database operation**. It rebuilds only the current browser runtime layout from the already fetched immutable projection. Registry Mode has one network fetch for the read-only index and no persistence, deletion, update or write channel. ```text HRAIN_GRAPH != REGISTRY_AUTHORITY REGISTRY_INDEX != SOURCE_OBJECT READ_ONLY_PRESENTATION != WRITE_AUTHORITY HRAIN_WIPE != REGISTRY_DELETE LOCAL_DESK_RESET != SOURCE_MUTATION JANUS_META_REGISTRY = APPEND_ONLY_FROM_HRAIN_PERSPECTIVE ``` ## Boundary ```text MATURITY = ACTIVE_PROTOTYPE NEURAL_DECODING = NOT_IMPLEMENTED CLINICAL_BCI_VALIDATION = NOT_PERFORMED MEDICAL_DEVICE_STATUS = NOT_CLAIMED REPOSITORY_LEVEL_REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE = NOT_CLAIMED MEASURED_COMMUNICATION_GAIN = NOT_ESTABLISHED MEASURED_BICAMERAL_COGNITIVE_GAIN = NOT_ESTABLISHED ``` Local operation can reduce unnecessary data exposure, but privacy/compliance depends on the full deployment, model provider, logging, and organizational controls. ## Review / run - Live demo: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/Hrain/ - JANUS Registry Mode: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/Hrain/janus.html - DemiHead left-hemisphere sidecar: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/Hrain/demihead.html - Machine-readable project status: [`PROJECT_STATUS.json`](PROJECT_STATUS.json) - Related prototype: [iNaiHR](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/iNaiHR) - Portfolio maturity/visibility: [`portfolio-visibility.json`](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/Janus/blob/main/portfolio-visibility.json) Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Leave external model configuration empty for local/offline use. ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Presentation follows the account's [public repository standard](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/Janus/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_PRESENTATION_STANDARD.md). No affiliation with MIT is implied by the presentation style.

name: HRAiN x TRUMP Full Meta Registry Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.janus/HRAIN_META_REGISTRY_TRUMP_AUDIT_CONTRACT.json'
      - 'tools/hrain_trump_meta_registry_audit.py'
      - '.github/workflows/hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.janus/HRAIN_META_REGISTRY_TRUMP_AUDIT_CONTRACT.json'
      - 'tools/hrain_trump_meta_registry_audit.py'
      - '.github/workflows/hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  full-current-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Validate HRAiN x TRUMP audit contract
        run: |
          python -m json.tool .janus/HRAIN_META_REGISTRY_TRUMP_AUDIT_CONTRACT.json >/dev/null
          python -m py_compile tools/hrain_trump_meta_registry_audit.py

      - name: Wake exact candidate TRUMP and preserve its authority ceiling
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/Janus-Demiurge.git /tmp/janus-demiurge
          mkdir -p artifacts
          python /tmp/janus-demiurge/trump/trump_candidate.py status >/dev/null
          python /tmp/janus-demiurge/trump/trump_candidate.py verify-source >/dev/null
          python /tmp/janus-demiurge/trump/trump_candidate.py selftest >/dev/null
          cp /tmp/janus-demiurge/trump/TRUMP_MANIFEST.json artifacts/TRUMP_MANIFEST.json
          git -C /tmp/janus-demiurge rev-parse HEAD > artifacts/trump-demiurge-head.txt
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          m=json.load(open('/tmp/janus-demiurge/trump/TRUMP_MANIFEST.json', encoding='utf-8'))
          a=m['activation']
          assert m['status']=='CANDIDATE_RUNTIME_TISSUE'
          assert a['wake_allowed'] is True and a['use_allowed'] is True
          assert a['proof_authority'] is False
          assert a['scientific_claim_promotion_authority'] is False
          assert a['command_authority'] is False
          assert m['scientific_boundary']['P_VS_NP']=='OPEN'
          print('TRUMP_CANDIDATE_WAKE_SOURCE_VERIFY_SELFTEST=PASS')
          print('TRUMP_AUTHORITY_CEILING=PRESERVED')
          PY

      - name: Freeze full-current Meta Registry catalog and its exact source commit
        run: |
          git clone --filter=blob:none --branch main --single-branch https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry.git /tmp/meta-catalog
          SOURCE_COMMIT=$(python - <<'PY'
          import json
          print(json.load(open('/tmp/meta-catalog/assets/hrain-full-memory/manifest.json', encoding='utf-8'))['source_commit'])
          PY
          )
          git -C /tmp/meta-catalog fetch --depth 1 origin "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
          git -C /tmp/meta-catalog worktree add --detach /tmp/meta-source "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
          printf '%s\n' "$SOURCE_COMMIT" > /tmp/meta-source/.janus-source-commit
          git -C /tmp/meta-catalog rev-parse HEAD > artifacts/meta-registry-catalog-head.txt
          printf '%s\n' "$SOURCE_COMMIT" > artifacts/meta-registry-frozen-source.txt
          echo "META_REGISTRY_CATALOG_HEAD=$(cat artifacts/meta-registry-catalog-head.txt)"
          echo "META_REGISTRY_FROZEN_SOURCE=$SOURCE_COMMIT"

      - name: Run TRUMP full-current structural and semantic-mechanics audit
        run: |
          python tools/hrain_trump_meta_registry_audit.py \
            --catalog-dir /tmp/meta-catalog \
            --source-dir /tmp/meta-source \
            --output artifacts/hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit.json \
            --top 150 | tee artifacts/hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit-summary.txt

      - name: Enforce fail-closed terminal
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          r=json.load(open('artifacts/hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit.json', encoding='utf-8'))
          assert r['terminal']=='FULL_CURRENT_STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY_AUDITED__SEMANTIC_MECHANICS_RANKED__AUTHORITY_UNCHANGED'
          assert not r['integrity']['errors']
          assert r['integrity']['objects_expected']==r['integrity']['objects_verified']
          assert r['source']['coverage_complete'] is True
          assert r['authority']['proof_authority'] is False
          assert r['scientific_boundary']['P_VS_NP']=='OPEN'
          print('HRAIN_META_REGISTRY_FULL_CURRENT_TRUMP_AUDIT=PASS')
          print('OBJECTS_VERIFIED=', r['integrity']['objects_verified'])
          print('BYTES_VERIFIED=', r['integrity']['bytes_verified'])
          print('MECHANIC_CANDIDATES=', r['trump_mechanic_projection']['candidate_file_count'])
          print('AXIS_FILE_COUNTS=', r['trump_mechanic_projection']['axis_file_counts'])
          print('ATTENTION_FLAGS=', r['trump_mechanic_projection']['attention_flag_count'])
          PY

      - name: Upload sealed audit receipts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: hrain-trump-meta-registry-audit
          path: artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

name: HRaiN JANUS Registry Mode integrity

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'janus.html'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/janus-registry-bridge-integrity.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'janus.html'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/janus-registry-bridge-integrity.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate living read-only Registry Mode contract
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re

          html = Path('janus.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          readme = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

          required = [
              'https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/assets/hrain-registry-index.json',
              'https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/',
              'https://hawkar-usls.github.io/iNaiHR/',
              'HRAIN_GRAPH != REGISTRY_AUTHORITY',
              'REGISTRY MODE',
              'READ ONLY',
              'APPEND-ONLY SOURCE',
              'WIPE LOCAL DESK',
              'LOCAL DESK CLEARED · JANUS REGISTRY UNTOUCHED',
              "janus.hrain.registry_graph_index.v1_0",
              'd3.forceManyBody()',
              '.velocityDecay(.58)',
              'organicPath',
              'animateImpulse',
              'neuron-membrane',
              'link-tendon',
              'DIVE',
              'ASCEND',
              'cloneRuntime()',
              'wipeLocalDesk',
          ]
          for marker in required:
              assert marker in html, marker

          # Registry Mode is a GET-only projection. It has no persistence or mutation channel.
          lowered = html.lower()
          assert 'contenteditable' not in lowered
          assert 'localstorage.' not in lowered
          assert 'indexeddb' not in lowered
          assert 'xmlhttprequest' not in lowered
          assert html.count('fetch(') == 1, 'Registry Mode must have exactly one network fetch'
          assert 'fetch(INDEX_URL' in html
          assert "method:'POST'" not in html and 'method:"POST"' not in html
          assert "method:'PUT'" not in html and 'method:"PUT"' not in html
          assert "method:'PATCH'" not in html and 'method:"PATCH"' not in html
          assert "method:'DELETE'" not in html and 'method:"DELETE"' not in html
          assert 'OPEN SOURCE' in html
          assert 'janus.html' in readme
          assert 'READ_ONLY_PRESENTATION != WRITE_AUTHORITY' in readme

          scripts = re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>', html, re.S)
          assert scripts, 'inline Registry Mode script missing'
          Path('/tmp/janus-inline.js').write_text(scripts[-1], encoding='utf-8')
          print('HRAIN_JANUS_REGISTRY_CONTRACT=PASS')
          print('HRAIN_JANUS_REGISTRY_READ_ONLY=TRUE')
          print('HRAIN_JANUS_REGISTRY_NETWORK_FETCHES=1_GET_ONLY')
          print('HRAIN_JANUS_REGISTRY_WIPE=LOCAL_RUNTIME_ONLY')
          print('HRAIN_JANUS_LIVING_PHYSICS=PASS')
          PY
          node --check /tmp/janus-inline.js
